main_body: Autumn tree: large orange leaf canopy (rows 2-33) on a brown trunk (rows 32-45)
top_band: Organic canopy: lit orange clumps (L~145) at upper parts of each leaf cluster over darker red-orange undersides; no flat rectangular top band, the volume reads as rounded clumps
evidence: Organic tree. The canopy is built from rounded clumps with lit tops (L145) stepping down to mid (112), dark (83) and deep (37-58) undersides, and a dark shadow mass above the trunk. The trunk is a visible vertical column with a base flare. There are no receding side faces and it is not a flat elevation, so it reads as a volumetric 3/4 tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against about 108 and 427-567 colours in the references. The canopy has 5 lightness steps (deep red-brown, dark, mid, light, highlight) and a tinted dark red-brown outline (0% neutral), with no flat 5x5 fills. But the shading is banded into clumps with little per-leaf texture, and the trunk is a simple brown column with few tones. Beside the leaf-by-leaf detail of the references it looks flatter and thinner.
